test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question:
How many six-lettered meaningful words can be formed using all these letters but each letter only once in the word. 

R F I

G E D
solution:
Given Letters : R, F, I, G, E, D

Only one meaningful six-letter word can be formed using the letters R, F, I, G, E, D.

Here, the only meaningful six-letter word is "FRIDGE".

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**.
